title: Normal numbers in sparse Cantor sets
summary: We consider Cantor-type sets of Hausdorff dimension zero, consisting of all numbers whose base-2 expansion can have a 1 only at positions belonging to a given sparse set (local count at least log k in every interval of length k). We prove that the measure induced by independent, non-identically distributed Bernoulli digits assigns full mass to numbers that are normal in every odd base.
